text: Yes. I’m German and had to do this for France and USA. What you need to do is sign an affidavit with a lawyer where you live. For the US one, I could do this at the embassy with their notarial services. For the French, I had to go to a lawyer in Israel (I’m already here). I prepared the document, saying basically “I lived in this country from dd.mm.yyyy to dd.mm.yyy and hereby declare that during this time I have never entered into marriage or civil partnership in this country. Since I am a citizen of x country, I could not obtain a copy of my civil records at the municipality, therefore this document shall act as proof of marriage status” of something along those lines. Lawyer/notary asks you if it’s all true and then they sign it. Apparently Misrad Hapanim is aware of which countries do or don’t offer this document and are used to accepting sworn affidavits instead.
